analysis:
Both units are CHANGELOG.md text only (head lines 1133-1571, the v0.10.3 tail, v0.10.2, v0.10.1 and early v0.10.0 release notes). The file_changes patch shows a documentation-only edit, a new v0.10.6 candidate section (head lines 11-808) above the existing notes. No executable code, configuration, protocol or crypto path changes in the supplied units, so I identified no concrete security regression.

Security-relevant claims in the notes that integration should compare with the threat model, none of which are verified here:
- SSD prefix-cache checkpoints (T-041, A-001). The notes describe new 4-bit balanced checkpoint layouts for Nemotron Super and GLM in their own cache namespaces, with a TTL sweep for old files, a deeper write queue (6 jobs) and cache-key repair after SE key replacement. The statements are consistent with T-041's HMAC-named, KEK-rooted, TTL-bound design. Actual code (SSDLookupKeys, SSDBlockStore) was not supplied. Whether the new layouts keep the AAD and metadata restrictions (nothing prompt-derived beyond the keyed lookup tag) cannot be confirmed from a changelog.
- The heartbeat per-model prefix-cache status now carries an optional `detail` field. This is operational, not prompt-derived.
- Logprob exposure and coordinator version floors (darkbloom-platform#464) are platform-owned.
- New cluster features in the v0.10.6 candidate (cluster_runtime in registration, pair approvals from releases, RDMA over Thunderbolt) appear only in the patch excerpt. That excerpt is truncated, so the new inter-Mac trust boundary and the registration-carried cluster runtime facts are not covered by existing threat IDs. The code and a threat-model update need review in the units that contain those sources.
- The Autopilot and desktop control API items (loopback authenticated API, downloads on the operator's behalf) relate to TB-003, A-008 and TB-012/TB-013. They are described in prose only.

No finding was raised because nothing in the supplied text proves a control was removed. Because the cluster section is only partly visible, I set needs_deeper_review to true for the code units.
